verdict.rationale: Community evidence indicates AutoGen executes agent-generated code inside a fresh Docker container by default, which functions as a sandbox isolating execution from the host/production environment, but this is not documented in the official docs excerpts and is corroborated by only a single hands-on comment. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the sandbox/Docker executor, guidance on isolating from production data/systems, and additional independent corroboration.
